sources.title: The O-CRA Framework — Formian Labs
sources.snippet: The framework examines how often a model picks up on strategic language without being prompted, how well it interprets policy statements, and how many times across a session a user has to re-anchor it in the organisation's goals.

sources.title: AI Tool to Predict Ovarian Cancer Treatment Response | OCRA
sources.snippet: With support from OCRA, researchers at The University of Texas Health Science Center developed a pioneering AI tool to better predict treatment response, a step toward earlier personalized treatment plans.

sources.title: Orca Hand
sources.snippet: The ORCA v1 hand is a tendon-driven, anthropomorphic robotic platform designed to closely replicate the structure and movement of a human hand. It features 17 degrees of freedom—16 in the fingers and 1 in the wrist—enabling a wide range of dexterous manipulation tasks. Its design balances functionality, reliability, and accessibility.
